meta.title: English Indices of Deprivation 2025 (LSOA 2021)
meta.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
meta.geography: LSOA21; LA and county summary counts
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics. First IoD on 2021 LSOAs; 33755 English LSOAs ranked. Education domain combines the Children & Young People sub-domain (attainment, absence, staying on, HE entry) and Adult Skills sub-domain (no/low qualifications, English proficiency, working-age adults, Census 2021).
meta.limitations: Ranks and deciles are relative: they show how an LSOA compares with others in England, not absolute levels, and a change of rank does not mean deprivation rose or fell. Not every person in a deprived LSOA is deprived. Not directly comparable with IoD2019 (2011 LSOAs, changed indicators). Domain scores (other than income and employment rates) are standardised composites without natural units. Indicator reference years vary (mostly 2022/23; Adult Skills uses Census 2021). LA summary rows here count LSOAs only; MHCLG's official LA summary measures (rank of average score etc.) are in File 10/11.
